recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up core FHIR change is needed for FHIR-12408 unless a future task explicitly audits historical DSTU2 publication artifacts rather than the current build.
issue_request: FHIR-12408 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU2 FHIR-core Questionnaire correction. It reported that que-11 used the XPath not(exists(f:type)) or exists(f:definition), which inverted the intended rule and rejected items that had type without definition; the requested XPath was exists(f:type) or exists(f:definition).
initial_application: The issue was applied in git-svn revision 11206, represented by commit b28d8fdbff34ad8889283857fba62a2f0581d82b, which changed the Questionnaire spreadsheet and sheet text to definition.exists() or type.exists() and exists(f:type) or exists(f:definition). Commit 7d4a41d1aedfd315ed05e3d3a37598c4f9034867 later removed the DefinitionOrType invariant as a technical correction because it had no effect once Questionnaire.item.type was required.
additional_context: Questionnaire is an active current-build resource in source/fhir.ini. Current source/questionnaire/structuredefinition-Questionnaire.xml defines Questionnaire.item.type with min=1/max=1, has no DefinitionOrType or historical XPath expressions, and now uses que-11 for a different answerOption/initial rule. Community searches found no relevant conflicting Zulip or Confluence evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because the bad XPath was corrected in history and the current authoritative source enforces the stronger present-day rule that type is always present.
